# Freudly

> > Freudly is a 24/7 AI-powered mental health platform offering free CBT therapy, psychological assessments, and emotional support in 10+ languages with end-to-end encryption.

Freudly provides accessible, anonymous AI-driven therapy and mental health testing using evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) techniques. The platform supports multiple languages and offers both conversational therapy sessions and standardized psychological assessments.

## Key Topics

- AI Therapy
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- 24/7 Mental Health Support
- End-to-End Encryption
- Psychological Assessments
- Emotional Wellness
- Online Counseling
- Anonymous Chat
- AI Chatbot
- Mental Health Tests
- Anxiety & Stress Support
- Personality Testing
- Evidence-Based Therapy
- Free Mental Health Service
- Multilingual Support

## Core Therapy Platform

- [AI Therapist Online - Free Therapy Sessions 24/7](https://freudly.ai): Freudly: AI-powered CBT therapy chatbot offering 24/7 anonymous mental health support
- [About Us](https://freudly.ai/about): Company mission: Making emotional well-being accessible via AI therapy
- [Reviews of Freudly](https://freudly.ai/reviews): User testimonials and reviews of Freudly AI psychology assistant

## Mental Health Assessments & Tests

- [Mental Health & Psychology Tests](https://freudly.ai/tests): AI-powered psychological assessments including APQ, CSES, and addiction screening
- [Enneagram Test - Free Online Personality Quiz](https://freudly.ai/tests/enneagram-personality-test): Free Enneagram personality test with AI-powered analysis and instant results

## Therapy Methods & Education

- [Types of Therapy](https://freudly.ai/types-of-therapy): Guide to therapy types: CBT, DBT, EMDR and evidence-based approaches
